시편-27-1.title: 시편 27장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-27-1.exegesis: 11-12. But, &c.-- He contrasts his character and destiny with that of the wicked (compare Psa 26:1 , 2).
시편-27-1.theologicalNote: 11-12. But, &c.-- He contrasts his character and destiny with that of the wicked (compare Psa 26:1 , 2).

시편-27-2.title: 시편 27장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-27-2.exegesis: PSALM 27 Psa 27:1-14 . With a general strain of confidence, hope, and joy, especially in God's worship, in the midst of dangers, the Psalmist introduces prayer for divine help and guidance. 1. light-- is a common figure for comfort. strength-- or, "stronghold"--affording security against all violence. The interrogations give greater vividness to the negation implied.

시편-27-3.title: 시편 27장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-27-3.exegesis: 2. eat ... my flesh-- ( Job 19:22 ; Psa 14:4 ). The allusion to wild beasts illustrates their rapacity. they stumbled-- "they" is emphatic; not I, but they were destroyed.
시편-27-3.theologicalNote: 2. eat ... my flesh-- ( Job 19:22 ; Psa 14:4 ). The allusion to wild beasts illustrates their rapacity. they stumbled-- "they" is emphatic; not I, but they were destroyed.

시편-27-4.title: 시편 27장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-27-4.exegesis: 3. In the greatest dangers. in this-- that is, then, in such extremity.
시편-27-4.theologicalNote: 3. In the greatest dangers. in this-- that is, then, in such extremity.

시편-27-5.title: 시편 27장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-27-5.exegesis: 4-5. The secret of his confidence is his delight in communion with God ( Psa 16:11 ; 23:6 ), beholding the harmony of His perfections, and seeking His favor in His temple or palace; a term applicable to the tabernacle (compare Psa 5:7 ). There he is safe ( Psa 31:21 ; 61:5 ). The figure is changed in the last clause, but the sentiment is the same.

시편-27-7.title: 시편 27장 7절 역사문법적 주해
시편-27-7.exegesis: 6. head be lifted up-- I shall be placed beyond the reach of my enemies. Hence he avows his purpose of rendering joyful thank offerings.
시편-27-7.theologicalNote: 6. head be lifted up-- I shall be placed beyond the reach of my enemies. Hence he avows his purpose of rendering joyful thank offerings.

시편-27-8.title: 시편 27장 8절 역사문법적 주해
시편-27-8.exegesis: 7. Still pressing need extorts prayer for help. cry with my voice-- denotes earnestness. Other things equal, Christians in earnest pray audibly, even in secret.
시편-27-8.theologicalNote: 7. Still pressing need extorts prayer for help. cry with my voice-- denotes earnestness. Other things equal, Christians in earnest pray audibly, even in secret.

시편-27-9.title: 시편 27장 9절 역사문법적 주해
시편-27-9.exegesis: 8. The meaning is clear, though the construction in a literal translation is obscure. The English Version supplies the implied clause. To seek God's face is to seek His favor ( Psa 105:4 ).
시편-27-9.theologicalNote: 8. The meaning is clear, though the construction in a literal translation is obscure. The English Version supplies the implied clause. To seek God's face is to seek His favor ( Psa 105:4 ).

시편-27-10.title: 시편 27장 10절 역사문법적 주해
시편-27-10.exegesis: 9. Hide not, &c.-- ( Psa 4:6 ; 22:24 ). Against rejection he pleads former mercy and love.
시편-27-10.theologicalNote: 9. Hide not, &c.-- ( Psa 4:6 ; 22:24 ). Against rejection he pleads former mercy and love.

시편-27-11.title: 시편 27장 11절 역사문법적 주해
시편-27-11.exegesis: 10. In the extremity of earthly destitution ( Psa 31:11 ; 38:11 ), God provides (compare Mt 25:35 ).
시편-27-11.theologicalNote: 10. In the extremity of earthly destitution ( Psa 31:11 ; 38:11 ), God provides (compare Mt 25:35 ).

시편-27-12.title: 시편 27장 12절 역사문법적 주해
시편-27-12.exegesis: 11. thy way-- of providence. a plain path-- ( Psa 26:12 ). enemies-- literally, "watchers for my fall" ( Psa 5:8 ).
시편-27-12.theologicalNote: 11. thy way-- of providence. a plain path-- ( Psa 26:12 ). enemies-- literally, "watchers for my fall" ( Psa 5:8 ).

시편-27-13.title: 시편 27장 13절 역사문법적 주해
시편-27-13.exegesis: 12. will-- literally, "soul," "desire" ( Psa 35:25 ). enemies-- literally, "oppressors." Falsehood aids cruelty against him. breathe out-- as being filled with it ( Ac 9:1 ).
시편-27-13.theologicalNote: 12. will-- literally, "soul," "desire" ( Psa 35:25 ). enemies-- literally, "oppressors." Falsehood aids cruelty against him. breathe out-- as being filled with it ( Ac 9:1 ).

시편-27-14.title: 시편 27장 14절 역사문법적 주해
시편-27-14.exegesis: 13. The strong emotion is indicated by the incomplete sentence, for which the English Version supplies a proper clause; or, omitting that, and rendering, "yet I believed," &c., the contrast of his faith and his danger is expressed. to see-- is to experience ( Psa 22:17 ).
